first_week.title: Safety in God’s presence
first_week.prayer: Father, cover my (son | daughter) with Your peace. Let their mind rest, their body relax, and their heart feel safe with You. Amen.

first_week.title: Healing hidden wounds
first_week.prayer: Lord, tend the places my (son | daughter) keeps hidden. Heal what hurts, comfort what aches, and replace heaviness with hope. Amen.

first_week.title: Protection from fear and anxiety
first_week.prayer: God, when fear rises in my (son | daughter), teach them to turn to You. Calm their thoughts and steady their breathing with Your peace. Amen.

first_week.title: Freedom from shame
first_week.prayer: Father, silence shame over my (son | daughter). Let them hear Your delight, not condemnation, and feel Your love without fear. Amen.

first_week.title: Healthy sleep and rest
first_week.prayer: Lord, give my (son | daughter) deep rest. Restore their nervous system and quiet their mind. Let sleep become healing again. Amen.

first_week.title: Gentle strength in weakness
first_week.prayer: God, where my (son | daughter) feels weak, supply strength. Meet them softly, not harshly, and carry them through today. Amen.

first_week.title: Trusting God’s timing
first_week.prayer: Father, help me trust Your timing for my (son | daughter). Even when progress feels slow, remind us You are working with purpose. Amen.

second_week.title: Courage to open up
second_week.prayer: Lord, give my (son | daughter) courage to speak honestly when the time is right. Replace fear with bravery and silence with truth. Amen.

second_week.title: Safe relationships and wise counsel
second_week.prayer: Father, bring safe people into my (son | daughter)’s life—those who lead them toward You, not toward darkness. Guard their friendships. Amen.

second_week.title: A soft, teachable heart
second_week.prayer: God, give my (son | daughter) a tender heart. Remove hardness, defensiveness, and numbness. Make them receptive to love and truth. Amen.

second_week.title: Honesty without fear of punishment
second_week.prayer: Lord, help my (son | daughter) believe confession leads to cleansing, not rejection. Teach them honesty is safe with You. Amen.

second_week.title: Healing the family communication
second_week.prayer: Father, shape my words toward my (son | daughter). Let our home be a place of gentleness, where truth can be spoken without explosion. Amen.

second_week.title: Wisdom to recognize triggers
second_week.prayer: God, help my (son | daughter) notice what pulls them toward temptation. Guard their heart and train their awareness with wisdom. Amen.

second_week.title: Breaking secrecy with light
second_week.prayer: Lord, draw my (son | daughter) toward the light. Replace hiding with healing and secrecy with freedom. Keep them safe as they step forward. Amen.

third_week.title: Deliverance from bondage
third_week.prayer: Father, lead my (son | daughter) out of darkness and break every chain that binds them. Bring freedom that is real and lasting. Amen.

third_week.title: Strength in temptation
third_week.prayer: Lord, make a clear way of escape for my (son | daughter). Give them power to pause, turn away, and choose what is clean. Amen.

third_week.title: Renewal after setbacks
third_week.prayer: God, if my (son | daughter) stumbles, lift them without shame. Teach them to get up quickly and return to You without despair. Amen.

third_week.title: New desires and clean motives
third_week.prayer: Father, create a clean heart in my (son | daughter). Purify their desires and restore a steady spirit that seeks what is holy. Amen.

third_week.title: Guarding eyes and imagination
third_week.prayer: Lord, help my (son | daughter) guard their eyes and imagination. Train their attention to turn toward what brings life, not lust. Amen.

third_week.title: Self-control by the Spirit
third_week.prayer: Holy Spirit, grow self-control in my (son | daughter). Not through pressure, but through Your power shaping their choices from within. Amen.

third_week.title: Peaceful mind and steady emotions
third_week.prayer: Father, when my (son | daughter) feels overwhelmed, comfort them with Your presence. Quiet their anxious thoughts and steady their emotions. Amen.

fourth_week.title: Identity anchored in God
fourth_week.prayer: Lord, remind my (son | daughter) they are chosen and loved. Let their identity be rooted in You, not in failure or performance. Amen.

fourth_week.title: Hope for their future
fourth_week.prayer: Father, direct the path of my (son | daughter). When they feel lost, lead them step by step into a future shaped by wisdom and grace. Amen.

fourth_week.title: Healing of mind and thought life
fourth_week.prayer: God, lift my (son | daughter)’s mind toward what is pure. Replace dark patterns with holy focus and quiet strength. Amen.

fourth_week.title: Pure heart, not perfection
fourth_week.prayer: Lord, give my (son | daughter) a pure heart. Teach them purity is a direction, a love for You, not flawless performance. Amen.

fourth_week.title: Healthy relationships and boundaries
fourth_week.prayer: Father, teach my (son | daughter) honor and boundaries. Form them to love with integrity and to treat themselves and others with respect. Amen.

fourth_week.title: Healing from regret and condemnation
fourth_week.prayer: Lord, meet my (son | daughter) with new mercy today. Wash away regret and replace condemnation with Your compassion. Amen.

fourth_week.title: A life of lasting transformation
fourth_week.prayer: Father, finish the good work You started in my (son | daughter). Make their life a testimony of grace, freedom, and a pure heart. Amen.
